title: Moai-kun - Beach
description:
With this, you can make your beach themed levels nicer looking! The beach background from Moai-kun, now in SMW.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
